summary: Russian forces conducted multiple strikes using guided aerial bombs on Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia regions and attacked warehouses in Dnepropetrovsk. Ukrainian authorities reported a strike on a children's hospital in Zaporizhzhia, though no casualties were reported. Simultaneous drone activity was reported across several Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, Sumy, and Chernihiv.
key_points: Russian forces launched guided aerial bombs (KAB) targeting the Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/71511).
Russian forces attacked warehouses in Dnepropetrovsk, resulting in a fire that lasted several hours with periodic secondary detonations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32164).
A Russian strike hit a children's hospital in Zaporizhzhia, damaging the facade and windows, but all children and medics were in shelters (Source: @UkraineNow/83196).
Groups of jet-powered UAVs were reported moving through Donetsk towards Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk regions (Source: @kpszsu/71520).
The SBU claims to have prevented over 50 assassination attempts on Ukrainian military personnel since the beginning of 2026 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32161).
A Tu-95MS bomber was spotted moving from Engels airfield, with preliminary reports suggesting redeployment to Olenya (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69679).
The external power supply to the Zaporizhzhia NPP was temporarily disrupted (Source: @tass_agency/388684).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have intensified strikes using guided aerial bombs against Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia, alongside attacks on infrastructure in Dnepropetrovsk. Ukrainian officials report significant drone activity across multiple northern and central regions, including Kyiv and Sumy. Additionally, the SBU is highlighting ongoing Russian intelligence efforts to assassinate military personnel via 'honey traps'.

points: The SBU has reported preventing more than 50 assassination attempts on military personnel since the start of 2026, involving methods such as explosives or poisoned drinks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32161).
President Zelenskyy has approved new SBU operations and is continuing efforts to clean the agency's internal structure (Source: @UkraineNow/83186).

Minister of Agrarian Policy Taras Vysotsky stated that losses to the agricultural sector due to idling ports in the Greater Odessa region could reach $3 billion this year (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32176).
Energy Minister Shmygal warned that Russia's current goal is to destroy water supplies, noting that attacks on electricity and heating occurred last winter (Source: @UkraineNow/83175).
In Odessa, TCC employees reportedly entered a residential complex under construction and kidnapped a group of workers (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32178).
A fire involving diesel fuel occurred in Perm, covering an area of 800 square meters before being localized to 600 square meters (Source: @tass_agency/388709; @tass_agency/388719).
The Russian State Duma passed laws to restrict individuals hiding abroad, including freezing accounts and denying online government services (Source: @tass_agency/388686).
A Russian paratrooper died after his parachute failed to open during a celebration near Moscow (Source: @eRadarrua/103963).
President Putin signed a law to monitor food prices across the entire supply chain, effective January 1, 2027 (Source: @tass_agency/388710).
Russian forces advanced near Shakhove (Source: @DeepStateUA/23720).
Guided aerial bombs (KAB) were used in attacks against the Donetsk region (Source: @kpszsu/71511).
Jet-powered UAV groups were reported in the Donetsk region moving toward Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk (Source: @kpszsu/71520).
Jet-powered UAVs were reported in the Chernihiv region, including groups moving toward Kyiv (Source: @eRadarrua/103982; @kpszsu/71493).
Jet-powered UAVs were spotted in the Sumy region passing Terny toward Dubovyazivka (Source: @eRadarrua/103988).
Jet-powered UAVs were reported in the Kyiv region, specifically near Zgurivka and Berezan (Source: @eRadarrua/103967).
Jet-powered UAVs were reported approaching Brovary from the direction of Slavutych (Source: @eRadarrua/103986; @eRadarrua/103989; @kpszsu/71506).
Jet-powered UAVs were reported in the Beryslav district of Kherson region, moving north (Source: @kpszsu/71489).
A commercial vessel named 'Yanina' sank in the Black Sea due to an attack by Ukrainian maritime drones; all 17 crew members were rescued (Source: @tass_agency/388687).
A Tu-95MS bomber was detected moving from Engels airfield, with potential redeployment to Olenya (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69679).
There was a threat of 'Kinzhal' aero-ballistic missile use (Source: @kpszsu/71504).
Two conventional Shahed drones and one jet-powered Shahed were reported in the Black Sea waters (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69707).
Jet-powered UAVs were reported in the Poltava and Cherkasy border regions, moving west (Source: @kpszsu/71489; @kpszsu/71521).

key_developments: Russian forces utilized guided aerial bombs (KAB) against targets in the Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/71511).
Russian military strikes hit warehouses in Dnepropetrovsk, causing prolonged fires and secondary detonations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32164).
A Tu-95MS bomber was observed transiting from Engels to potentially Olenya airfield (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69679).
The SBU reported preventing over 50 assassination attempts on Ukrainian military personnel since early 2026 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32161).
The external power supply to the Zaporizhzhia NPP was temporarily interrupted (Source: @tass_agency/388684).
A commercial vessel, 'Yanina', sank in the Black Sea following an attack by Ukrainian maritime drones (Source: @tass_agency/388687).
Russian forces advanced in the vicinity of Shakhove (Source: @DeepStateUA/23720).
sections.threat_assessment: The threat level remains high due to the combination of guided aerial bomb strikes and jet-powered UAV incursions across central and northern Ukraine. Russian intelligence is actively employing 'honey trap' tactics to target Ukrainian military personnel. The potential for continued strikes on energy and water infrastructure remains a critical concern for Ukrainian stability.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is responding by approving new SBU operations and focusing on internal agency purification. The government is also preparing for potential winter energy attacks targeting water and sewerage systems. In the agricultural sector, officials are monitoring the economic impact of port closures in the Odessa region.
sections.intelligence_notes: The deployment of jet-powered UAVs suggests an evolution in drone tactics to bypass traditional air defenses. The reported movement of Tu-95MS bombers indicates readiness for long-range strategic strikes. Additionally, the reported use of 'honey traps' by Russian intelligence highlights a persistent asymmetric threat to Ukrainian personnel.
